_comment: Visual templates for daily Instagram posts. Each one is a recipe — Gemini generates content, image-generator renders it.

templates.title: Daily Brain Teaser
templates.prompt: Generate ONE multiple-choice question for Class {classLevel} CBSE students on {subject}. Format: question, 4 options, correct answer letter, brief explanation. Make it interesting and exam-relevant. Subject should rotate between Maths, Science, English, Social Studies. Class level should be 5-10. Keep question under 25 words. Options under 8 words each.

templates.title: Logic Puzzle
templates.prompt: Generate ONE short logical reasoning or maths puzzle suitable for students Class 6-10. Include: puzzle text (under 40 words), a hint (one line), and the solution. Make it tricky but solvable in 2 minutes. Examples: number patterns, age problems, geometric puzzles, lateral thinking.

templates.title: GK Question
templates.prompt: Generate ONE interesting General Knowledge question for Indian school students Class 6-12. Topics: Indian history, Indian geography, Indian polity, science discoveries, sports, current affairs 2025-26, awards, Indian culture. Include: question, 4 options, correct answer letter, and a fun fact explanation.

templates.title: NCERT Study Tip
templates.prompt: Generate ONE actionable NCERT study tip for Indian students Class 8-12. Make it specific (not vague advice). Examples: how to draw Biology diagrams, how to solve Physics numericals fast, how to remember Chemistry reactions, how to write English essays for boards, how to memorise History dates. Tip should be 2-3 lines max. Include a subject, the tip, and why it works.

templates.title: Exam Update
templates.prompt: Generate ONE realistic-sounding education news headline about Indian student exams for May/June 2026. Topics: CBSE board notifications, JEE Mains dates, NEET schedule, EAMCET registration, NCERT changes, state board updates. Format: short headline (under 12 words), 1-2 sentence summary, and a key takeaway action item for students. DO NOT fabricate specific dates that contradict reality — use vague timing like 'this week', 'coming soon', 'announced recently'.

templates.title: Motivation
templates.prompt: Generate ONE short motivational message for Indian students preparing for boards/JEE/NEET. Mention something specific and relatable (not generic). Format: a punchy headline (under 10 words), 2-3 lines of body text, and a call-to-action. Tone: warm, encouraging, like a senior helping a junior.

templates.title: Coding Tip
templates.prompt: Generate ONE practical coding tip for Indian students learning Python or JavaScript Class 8-12. Include: language, the tip, a short code example (2-4 lines), and what bug/issue it prevents. Make it beginner-friendly. Examples: list comprehensions, f-strings, array map/filter, try/except, debugging tips.
